line_count_convention.authoritative: git show <commit>:<path> | wc -l == git blob newline count == [IO.File]::ReadAllLines().Count
line_count_convention.cause: PowerShell 5.1 Get-Content default ANSI (cp936) decoding undercounts UTF-8 files; -Encoding UTF8 gives 498/446
